title: Terra Nova
description: Enhances the Vanilla progression system, while adding world-building features. More to come...
body:
This mod overhauls the progression of the game.
You will start more bare-bones than before, relying on foraging to upgrade through flint and bone hatchets.
You will love campfires and appreciate the Terraria reference.

The furnace is preceded by a kiln. The crafting table is preceded by a field crafting table. Everything is gated but in the best way possible.

Also added shelf fungi inspired Creeping Mushrooms. You'll love it.

And, if any of this intrigues you, there is more to come. Stay tuned for more world-building and magic features galore!
